goals: Limit new Xaero Minimap and World Map terrain discovery to a configurable chunk-quantized Euclidean circle, defaulting to radius 2, independently of Minecraft render distance.

Preserve all previously mapped terrain and otherwise preserve Xaero behavior, including normal nearby discovery, Minimap and World Map sharing, waypoints, radar, navigation, map presentation, and unrelated UI behavior.
Apply durable singleplayer eligibility independently to Xaero World Map's exact persistent vertical-layer identity while failing open whenever history integrity cannot be trusted.
scope: Maintain the client-side Fabric companion for Minecraft 26.2 against exact Xaero Minimap 26.4.2, Xaero World Map 1.44.2, and embedded XaeroLib 1.7.1 references.

Apply the inclusive chunk-circle predicate dx squared plus dz squared less than or equal to radius squared, configurable from 0 through 32 and defaulting to 2 for a fresh or invalid configuration, across Minimap live terrain reads and World Map live writing without reading or changing Minecraft render distance or widening a tighter native Xaero distance.
Center both live gates on Xaero's current camera semantics: Minimap uses Minecraft's current camera entity and World Map uses its camera-derived playerChunkX and playerChunkZ fields.

Persist singleplayer eligibility by Xaero World Map caveLayer: Integer.MAX_VALUE for surface, Integer.MIN_VALUE for full or single-depth mode, and signed caveStart shifted right by 4 for ordinary cave layers; gate direct-save reconstruction with the destination tile region's exact caveLayer.

Preserve every valid C1 history entry as read-only wildcard eligibility across all vertical layers, append all new eligibility to a separate dimension-local layer-aware v2 journal, and never rewrite or delete the v1 journal.

Seed pre-policy discovery only from exact frozen hashes of existing .xwmc or .xwmc.outdated cache files, recording each imported chunk under its exact Xaero layer while leaving existing cache textures and map data intact.
Maintain forced pending transactions and durable fail-open behavior for interrupted, corrupt, unavailable, mismatched, or otherwise untrustworthy history and cache-manifest state.

exclusions: A successor beyond Canary 2, dependency-version expansion, server-side behavior, or broad redesign of Xaero discovery and map storage.
Modification, patching, or redistribution of Xaero Minimap, Xaero World Map, XaeroLib, their classes, or their assets; the exact All Rights Reserved binaries remain external references only.

Deleting, rewriting, or concealing existing Xaero map data, rewriting the C1 v1 history, grandfathering every pre-generated Anvil chunk, or fabricating missing historical discovery without durable Xaero cache evidence.
Changing Minecraft render distance, waypoint or radar reach, map navigation, zoom, cache rendering, or unrelated Xaero behavior.
Minecraft launch, deployment, Test Slot changes, accepted-baseline changes, Test Instance Manager changes, runtime-profile access, or protected gameplay-instance access during this task.
Runtime claims about Mixin application, freecam or camera-mod behavior, vertical-layer transitions, direct-save timing, migration cost, or any behavior not actually observed with Canary 2.
